en: The postcard features a black-and-white photographic image showing a stylish, manicured garden scene dominated by palm trees in large planters along a wide pathway. There are formal bushes and potted plants, with benches and a decorative metal gazebo visible in the background. The text identifies the garden as part of Bad Pyrmont and specifically names it the 'Palmengarten'. The back of the postcard includes spaces for address and stamp, and is stamped with the logo of the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont. The vertical text reads 'Aufnahme u. Verlag von Ernst Hermann, Bad Pyrmont.'
